foundation.name: Synthetic Agency Invoices

problem.value: Choosing which overdue invoice needs attention may take too long

workaround.value: A small unfinished local JavaScript invoice tracker

desiredOutcome.value: See the oldest unpaid overdue invoices first

solution.value: The founder reports that the tracker totals unpaid invoices

constraints: Preserve existing JavaScript modules, manifest and instructions
Local synthetic records only; no reminders or email
unknowns: Whether this ordering helps the owner decide the next manual follow-up
Buyer and willingness to pay are unknown

intention.statement: A profitable solo business; keep the JavaScript application.

consequence.value: Delays may consume time that could be spent on paid work

assessment.promising: The reported weekly workflow gives us a specific decision to examine.
assessment.weak: No customer contact or willingness to pay has been established.
assessment.criticalUnknown: What makes choosing the next follow-up difficult?
assessment.cheapestCheck: Walk through one recent receivables review.

brief.summary: Your tracker already totals unpaid invoices. My hypothesis is that choosing the next follow-up during a weekly review may be the missing value; customer demand remains unknown.
questions: Is deciding which invoice needs attention the problem you want to solve?
